name: Anti-Clockwise
source:
Anti-Clockwise is a horror/romance visual novel revolving around the concept of time travel. Moving up from high school to university can be hard, but what happens is nowhere near what was expected. In the game, you'll be able to meet new and old faces from your character's perspective and decide who will be the ones that will keep you company throughout this journey. With you having a strange ability, what could go wrong? 

[Edited from [url=https://kenny-snow.itch.io/anti-clockwise]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《逆时针》是一部围绕时间旅行概念的恐怖/浪漫视觉小说。从高中升入大学可能很困难，但所发生的事情与预期相去甚远。在游戏中，你将能够从角色的角度遇到新老面孔，并决定谁将在整个旅程中陪伴你。你拥有奇怪的能力，会出什么问题吗？

[编辑自[url=https://kenny-snow.itch.io/anti-clockwise]Itch.io[/url]]
